messages:
Priya: Quick heads-up — we need a short internal blurb for Thursday's staging->prod rollout. Draft below, please skim and flag anything risky. Also confirm version pin, change window, and rollback criteria. Target change window 02:00-03:00 UTC.

Priya: DRAFT: 'Going to roll the inference runtime (rdx-serving) 2.1.3 -> 2.1.4 in the EU/US regions during the 02:00-03:00 UTC maintenance window on Thu. This release includes latency improvements for long-context workloads and a safer KV-cache eviction policy. Expected impact: brief API restarts per instance during cutover. On-call will monitor latency/error dashboards and can trigger rollback. No customer-facing changes.':eyes:

Emily: Suggest we pin to rdx-serving@2.1.4-fp16. Latency wins on fp16. If memory pressure observed, fallback to 2.1.4-quant is acceptable for the low-tier pool.

Jonah: For rollback rules propose: rollback if 1) 5m error rate > 2.5% (baseline ~0.5%), OR 2) p95 latency increases > 200ms for 5+ min, OR 3) deploybot reports >3 failed instances during canary. Thoughts?

Sam: I'll wire the deploybot plan. Proposed timeline: schedule job at 02:10 UTC -> canary 5% for 10m -> verify automated smoke (health + sample inference checks) -> ramp to 30% -> final cutover 02:40. If any check fails, auto-suspend and notify #eng-oncall.

Priya: Jonah's thresholds look good. Let's tighten error threshold to 2% to be conservative. Add a manual abort check at the 10m canary mark.

Emily: Smoke tests (will run): `curl -X POST https://int-api/serve -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}'` check 200 + output token count. I'll add a quick eval set in S3 under s3://rdx-evals/staging/2.1.4/smoke.json

DeployBot: Deploy job scheduled: id=deploy-20260326-1763459999, window=02:00-03:00 UTC. Canary=5% (10m), ramp to 30% then 100%. Auto-suspend on health failures. Notifications: #eng-oncall, #eng-releases.

LegalBot: Confirmed — internal blurb ok. No customer-facing wording changes allowed without legal signoff.

Sam: Added manual checkpoint at canary end. Also attaching quick rollback command in ops-runbook: `opsctl rollout rollback --job deploy-20260326-1763459999 --reason "auto/threshold"`

Priya: Final copy to post internally: 'FYI: rdx-serving 2.1.4 rollout Thurs 02:00-03:00 UTC. Expect short restarts; on-call monitoring. Pin: 2.1.4-fp16 with quant fallback. Rollback triggers: 5m error rate >2%, p95 +200ms >5m, >3 failed instances in canary. Deploybot job deploy-20260326-1763459999. No customer-facing changes.'

Emily: LGTM :thumbsup:

Jonah: LGTM. I'll be up for rollback assistance if needed.

Sam: Deploybot will post start/finish logs to the thread and update the deploy ticket. I'll also leave a quick checklist in the ticket.

Priya: Thanks — locking this copy and scheduling the announce for 01:30 UTC (internal channel). @eng-oncall please ack availability 02:00-04:00 UTC.

DeployBot: Reminder scheduled at 01:30 UTC to post internal announce in #eng-releases.

Priya: Perfect. :raised_hands:
